name: Joyvo Product Designer
author: joyvo

sections.description:
Let every shopper design their own product on your store – and get each order made without retyping a thing.

Joyvo Product Designer puts a full product designer inside WooCommerce. Shoppers add text, art and photos to your products, see every side and color live, approve a proof and buy. Every order arrives with the approved design and print-ready files – ready for you to print, for Joyvo to print and ship, or, with Pro, sent straight to your own Printful, Printify or Gelato account.

Why stores choose it

  • Orders that make themselves – with Pro, paid orders go to your own Printful, Printify or Gelato account with the right size, color and a print file for every side.
  • Made for phones – a touch toolbar and a sheet for every tool, so shoppers design as easily on a phone as on a computer.
  • Every side, every color – front, back, sleeves and labels each keep their own design; every color previews live, with a 3D preview.
  • Print-ready files on every order – each printed side at its real size, up to 300 DPI, with a print check that warns about blurry photos.
  • Text that sells – 64 fonts and curved text in 9 shapes, edited right on the product.
  • Your brand, not ours – your logo in the designer, or no brand at all with Pro.
  • Free to start – the designer on every product, customer proofs, saved designs and print files cost nothing.

Add a Customize button to any WooCommerce product. Your customer designs it on your site — text, artwork, uploads, colors, print areas — and the finished design is attached to their cart item and carried through to the order.

What the customer made is what gets produced. The design reference travels with the line item, so nothing is retyped, re-uploaded, or guessed at when the order is fulfilled.

Connects to Printful, Printify and Gelato

Designing is only half the job. This designer also hands every paid order to your print service, so nothing is re-entered by hand:

  • Printful – with Designer Pro, connect your own Printful account with its API key. Each paid order is created in Printful with the right product, size and color, and a print file for every printed side.
  • Printify and Gelato – connect your own account the same way, and set each product’s print service product once.
  • Your account, your cost – you charge your own prices and keep your margin.
  • Held for you to confirm, or sent straight to production – you choose.
  • Prefer not to use a print service? Print it yourself, or have Joyvo print and ship it for you.

What it does

On your store
* A Customize button on any product you choose – the designer opens in place, your customer never leaves your store
* Works on a phone as well as a computer – a touch toolbar and a sheet for every tool
* Your logo in the designer, or no brand at all (white label)
* A “Design yours” button anywhere on your site – shortcode, block or Elementor widget – that opens the product with the designer ready
* Your rules per product: which print areas, techniques, tools and template categories customers get
* A setup checklist that shows what is done and what is left, with a link to fix each
* The color and size picked on the product page open the designer already set to them
* Sold-out colors and sizes of products Joyvo prints are marked on the product page, cannot be picked and are refused at the cart and at checkout
Products
* Hundreds of products to design on: apparel, hats, mugs, bags, home goods and more – or your own blanks
* Your own blanks: photograph the garments you stock, mark each print area and its size, and customers design on them
* Every side: front, back, sleeves, labels and more – each side keeps its own design
* Every color previewed live – two-tone colors shown as split swatches, and the design keeps its look when the color changes
* Product info right in the designer: price, every color and the price of every size
* A 3D preview
* Printing, embroidery and direct-to-film, with thread colors for embroidery
Text
* 64 fonts with color, size, spacing and alignment, edited right on the product
* Curved text in 9 shapes: arc up, arc down, circle, wave, bridge, flag, inflate, S-curve and spiral
* Text effects: outline, shadow, glow, neon and retro
* Upload your own fonts (.ttf, .otf, .woff) and use them like any other
Images and art
* Uploads of photos, SVG, PDF, Illustrator (AI), EPS and Photoshop (PSD) files, with background removal and crop
* 8 photo filters: black and white, sepia, vintage, dramatic, bright, high contrast, invert and original
* Photo masks in 8 shapes: circle, heart, star, hexagon, diamond, triangle, arch and rounded corners
* Free stock photos, searchable
* Clipart and icons, with every color in them changeable
* Shapes: rectangle, circle, triangle, star, heart and hexagon
* Freehand drawing with pencil, spray, circle brush and eraser
* QR codes for a website, phone number, text message, email or Wi-Fi – sharp vector codes at any size
* Contact-card QR codes that save you straight into someone’s phone
* Barcodes – Code 128, EAN-13 and UPC-A
* Trackable QR codes: a short link on your site counts every scan
* Describe a design and AI creates it – or describe a picture and AI paints it
* 24+ ready templates, every word editable, applied in one tap
Editing
* Layers you can show, hide, lock, duplicate, reorder and delete
* Align left, right, top, bottom or center; flip; bring forward or send back
* Select everything (or pick several parts on a phone) and move, scale and rotate it together
* Zoom in and out
* A grid in inches or centimeters over the print area, with snap, and the printed size of whatever you select
* Undo and redo, with the design kept if the page reloads
* A color picker with an eyedropper on phones
* A print check before ordering: a photo too small to print sharp is flagged with its real DPI
Ordering
* A live price that follows the design, size by size
* Several sizes in one go, each with its own quantity
* Your customer approves a proof before the design goes on their order
* A preview of the design on the product page, in the cart, at checkout and on the order
* The cart shows which sides are printed
* My designs in My Account: every approved design kept, with Edit again and Remove
* Edit again opens the designer on that product with the design loaded – change it and order more
* Designs made before signing in move to the account on sign-in, with one-tap sign-in right where it was saved
Pricing
* A price for each print area (front=0, back=5, sleeve_left=3) – or one fee per extra area
* Screen setup per ink color, counted from the real design
* Quantity breaks and a rush option
* Product options you reuse on any product – dropdowns, color swatches, text and number fields – each adding a fixed amount or a percentage
* Show an option only when another option has a certain choice
* Custom sizes priced by area – width x height x your rate, with a minimum price
* A turnaround table – standard, express, next day – each with its own price
* Starter price sheets for t-shirts, business cards and banners, and a price tester on every product
* Nothing sold without a price: designable products with no price are flagged
Production
* Every order carries the approved proof and a print-ready file for every printed side
* Production files on every order: each side as a real-size PDF with bleed and crop marks, or CMYK, plus a one-page production sheet
* Print files made at each print area’s real size, up to 300 DPI, and a print check that warns about blurry photos and art outside the print area
* Print it yourself, or have paid orders printed and shipped for you
* Connect your own Printful, Printify or Gelato account: paid orders are created there with the right size, color and a file for every side, at your cost – held for you to confirm, or straight to production
* Sell this design: with Joyvo Marketplace, sellers put their artwork on your products at their own price
* Quote-only products: customers design and request a quote; you price it on the Quotes screen and they pay from a link
* Approve each design before it prints, if you like – paid orders wait for you on the Production screen
* A production queue: every designed item from New to Printing to Done, with its files
* Who prints it, per product – products you print yourself never go to the print service
* A signed webhook and a “ready to produce” email when an order is ready to print
* One reminder to signed-in customers who kept a design but never ordered it (only when you switch it on)
* A Design column in your orders list

Free and Pro

Free
* The designer on every product: text, art, uploads, AI, templates, every side
* Proof approval by the customer before they buy
* Saved designs in My Account, Edit again, designs kept through sign-in
* Print-ready files for every side on each order
* Send paid orders to Joyvo to print and ship, or print them yourself
* Never breaks your theme – no scripts loaded into your store

Get started
* A 3-step setup: connect in one click, what you sell, who prints – and your store is ready
* Ready sample products made for you as drafts: T-shirts, business cards, flyers, postcards, stickers, folded cards, labels, posters
* A library of standard sizes – US and EU business cards, Letter / A4 / A5 flyers, 6 x 4 postcards, stickers, labels, 18 x 24 posters – at real size with the 1/8 in bleed and every side set
* Edit a blank once and every product using it changes

Pro – Designer Pro, All-in-one or Agency
* Your own print-on-demand account – orders go to your account, at your cost
* The Product Builder: options, sizes priced by area, minimum prices, turnaround, starter price sheets, price tester
* Quotes: “Request a quote” products, priced by you, paid by a link
* Approve each design before it is printed, a production queue, a “ready to produce” email and signed webhooks
* Print-ready PDF with crop marks, CMYK TIFF and a production sheet per order
* Your brand only – no Joyvo branding in the designer
* Reminders for designs customers kept but never ordered

What it does not do

  • It does not change your prices. WooCommerce charges exactly what you configured; the design is attached to the line item, never a source of truth about money.
  • It does not touch products you have not enabled.

Requirements

A Joyvo account and an API key from it. The designer and the production side run on Joyvo; this plugin is the bridge between that and your WooCommerce store.

External services

This plugin connects to Joyvo (https://www.joyvo.com), which provides the design tool and the printing and fulfillment behind it. The plugin does not function without it.

When a product linked to a Joyvo blank is shown, added to the cart or checked out. Your server asks https://www.joyvo.com/api/products/ for what that blank can still be sold in, sending only the blank’s product ID and the country it ships to. No API key and no customer details are sent. Answers are kept for two minutes.

When the designer is opened. Your server asks https://www.joyvo.com/api/plugins/designer/embed-token for a
short-lived link (sending your API key, your site’s address and, if set, the Joyvo product ID). Only that
link reaches the page – your API key never does. The design is created inside the frame and, once your
customer approves the proof, saved to your Joyvo account.

When a design is added to the cart. The plugin sends the design ID, your API key and your site’s domain to https://www.joyvo.com/api/plugins/designer/verify, to confirm the design exists and belongs to your account. No customer details are sent.

When an order is paid (only if you chose to have orders printed for you). The plugin sends to https://www.joyvo.com/api/plugins/designer/orders: your API key, your site’s domain, the WooCommerce order number, the design IDs and quantities on that order, and the shipping name, address, and the billing email address — the details required to produce and deliver the item. This is the only point at which personal data leaves your site, and it happens only for orders that contain a design.

When you press Connect with Joyvo. Your server sends https://www.joyvo.com/api/plugins/connect/start this site’s address, the dashboard page to return to and a one-time secret it made, and receives a ten-minute link. You sign in on Joyvo and press Connect; back on your dashboard, your server sends the link’s code and its secret to https://www.joyvo.com/api/plugins/connect/claim and receives your API key, which it keeps like a pasted one. The key never passes through your browser.

When you save the settings page. Your API key and your site’s domain are sent to https://www.joyvo.com/api/plugins/init to check the key is valid.

No personal data about your visitors is sent unless they pay for an order.

Joyvo’s terms of service: https://www.joyvo.com/terms
Joyvo’s privacy policy: https://www.joyvo.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to WooCommerce → Product Designer and press Connect with Joyvo. Sign in (or open a free account), press Connect, and you come straight back, connected – no key to copy. Prefer to paste an API key? That works too.
  3. Edit any product, open Product data → General, and tick Customers can design this.
  4. Optionally set a Joyvo product ID to fix which blank it prints on. Leave it empty to let the customer choose.

The product page now shows a Customize button.
sections.faq:
Does it work with Printful?

Yes. With Designer Pro, connect your own Printful account under Who prints the orders in the plugin settings, using the API key from Printful’s Settings > API. Each paid order is created in Printful with the right product, size and color and a print file for every printed side – held for you to confirm, or sent straight to production.

Can I use Printify or Gelato instead?

Yes, with Designer Pro. Connect your account the same way, then set each designable product’s print service product once in Product data > Product Designer (Printify: blueprint id and print provider id; Gelato: the product code).

Do I need a print-on-demand account at all?

No. On the free plan you can print orders yourself from the files on each order, or send paid orders to Joyvo to print and ship.

Will it work with my theme?

Yes. The designer opens in place on your product page and loads no scripts into your store’s pages, so it does not change your theme.

Does it work on phones?

Yes. On a phone the designer has a touch toolbar and opens each tool in its own sheet.

What can my customers design?

Hundreds of products – apparel, hats, mugs, bags, home goods and more – or your own blanks: photograph the garments you stock and mark each print area. Printing, embroidery (with thread colors) and direct-to-film are supported.

What is free and what needs Pro?

Free: the designer on every product, customer proofs, saved designs, print-ready files and sending orders to Joyvo or printing them yourself. Pro (Designer Pro, All-in-one or Agency) adds your own Printful, Printify or Gelato account, the Product Builder, quotes, design approval and a production queue, print PDFs with crop marks, white label and design reminders.

Do I need a Joyvo account?

Yes – a free one. The design tool and the printing behind it run on Joyvo. Press Connect with Joyvo in the plugin, sign in or open your account, and the plugin connects itself; nothing to copy.

Does this change my prices?

No. WooCommerce charges exactly what you set on the product. The design is attached to the line item; nothing in this plugin can alter what a customer is charged.

What happens if the hand-off to production fails?

It is written to the order as a note rather than silently dropped, so you can see it and retry. A production hand-off that fails quietly is how a paid order never ships.

Will the same order be produced twice?

No. WooCommerce fires both processing and completed for the same order, and merchants retry failed hand-offs, so the order is keyed on your store’s order number and only ever produced once.

Can a customer attach someone else’s design to their order?

No. The design reference arrives through the browser, so it is re-checked on the server against the account behind your API key before it is attached to anything.

* Sell this design: with Joyvo Marketplace, sellers put their artwork on your products at their own price
* Quote-only products: customers design and request a quote; you price it on the Quotes screen and they pay from a link
* Approve each design before it prints, if you like – paid orders wait for you on the Production screen
* A production queue: every designed item from New to Printing to Done, with its files
* Who prints it, per product – products you print yourself never go to the print service
* A signed webhook and a “ready to produce” email when an order is ready to print
* One reminder to signed-in customers who kept a design but never ordered it (only when you switch it on)
* A Design column in your orders list

Free and Pro

Free
* The designer on every product: text, art, uploads, AI, templates, every side
* Proof approval by the customer before they buy
* Saved designs in My Account, Edit again, designs kept through sign-in
* Print-ready files for every side on each order
* Send paid orders to Joyvo to print and ship, or print them yourself
* Never breaks your theme – no scripts loaded into your store

Get started
* A 3-step setup: connect in one click, what you sell, who prints – and your store is ready
* Ready sample products made for you as drafts: T-shirts, business cards, flyers, postcards, stickers, folded cards, labels, posters
* A library of standard sizes – US and EU business cards, Letter / A4 / A5 flyers, 6 x 4 postcards, stickers, labels, 18 x 24 posters – at real size with the 1/8 in bleed and every side set
* Edit a blank once and every product using it changes

Pro – Designer Pro, All-in-one or Agency
* Your own print-on-demand account – orders go to your account, at your cost
* The Product Builder: options, sizes priced by area, minimum prices, turnaround, starter price sheets, price tester
* Quotes: “Request a quote” products, priced by you, paid by a link
* Approve each design before it is printed, a production queue, a “ready to produce” email and signed webhooks
* Print-ready PDF with crop marks, CMYK TIFF and a production sheet per order
* Your brand only – no Joyvo branding in the designer
* Reminders for designs customers kept but never ordered

What it does not do

  • It does not change your prices. WooCommerce charges exactly what you configured; the design is attached to the line item, never a source of truth about money.
  • It does not touch products you have not enabled.

Requirements

A Joyvo account and an API key from it. The designer and the production side run on Joyvo; this plugin is the bridge between that and your WooCommerce store.

External services

This plugin connects to Joyvo (https://www.joyvo.com), which provides the design tool and the printing and fulfillment behind it. The plugin does not function without it.

When a product linked to a Joyvo blank is shown, added to the cart or checked out. Your server asks https://www.joyvo.com/api/products/ for what that blank can still be sold in, sending only the blank’s product ID and the country it ships to. No API key and no customer details are sent. Answers are kept for two minutes.

When the designer is opened. Your server asks https://www.joyvo.com/api/plugins/designer/embed-token for a
short-lived link (sending your API key, your site’s address and, if set, the Joyvo product ID). Only that
link reaches the page – your API key never does. The design is created inside the frame and, once your
customer approves the proof, saved to your Joyvo account.

When a design is added to the cart. The plugin sends the design ID, your API key and your site’s domain to https://www.joyvo.com/api/plugins/designer/verify, to confirm the design exists and belongs to your account. No customer details are sent.

When an order is paid (only if you chose to have orders printed for you). The plugin sends to https://www.joyvo.com/api/plugins/designer/orders: your API key, your site’s domain, the WooCommerce order number, the design IDs and quantities on that order, and the shipping name, address, and the billing email address — the details required to produce and deliver the item. This is the only point at which personal data leaves your site, and it happens only for orders that contain a design.

When you press Connect with Joyvo. Your server sends https://www.joyvo.com/api/plugins/connect/start this site’s address, the dashboard page to return to and a one-time secret it made, and receives a ten-minute link. You sign in on Joyvo and press Connect; back on your dashboard, your server sends the link’s code and its secret to https://www.joyvo.com/api/plugins/connect/claim and receives your API key, which it keeps like a pasted one. The key never passes through your browser.

When you save the settings page. Your API key and your site’s domain are sent to https://www.joyvo.com/api/plugins/init to check the key is valid.

No personal data about your visitors is sent unless they pay for an order.
